description: The workspace's recent activity: who did what and when, across the app and every agent connection. Each event has an actor (a human user, an agent via a token or sign-in, or the system scheduler), the action (rule created/updated/enabled/disabled/deleted, run triggered, Merchant Center link started/completed, Merchant Center account chosen), the feed, and a short summary. Use it to check what changed lately, or what you and others have already done, before acting again. Note that counts in a summary are preview SAMPLE counts, not catalog totals: compare them against the sampled figure alongside them. On a workspace with hourly feeds, scheduled runs dominate the newest events, so pass actorTypes to see human and agent changes.

actorTypes.description: Narrow to these actor types. Omit for everything. Pass ["user","agent"] to skip scheduled runs, which are high volume on hourly feeds and can fill the window on their own.

limit.description: How many events to return, newest first (max 100, default 50).

name: get_activity
title: Get activity
